brief.title: Global Cost of Living Crisis Index 2026: A Comparative Analysis of Economic Stress Across Cities and Regions
brief.one_liner: An analytical report examining cost-of-living pressures, affordability gaps, and economic stress indicators across 80 major cities worldwide in 2026.
brief.goal: Provide policy analysts and economic researchers with a clear understanding of which cities and regions face the most severe cost-of-living crises, what factors drive affordability challenges, and how income levels interact with living costs to create economic stress — enabling evidence-based prioritization of policy interventions.

required_sections.title: Executive Overview
required_sections.objective: Summarize the global cost-of-living landscape in 2026, highlighting the range of crisis tiers observed, the most and least affordable cities, and key headline statistics.

required_sections.title: Regional Cost-of-Living Comparison
required_sections.objective: Compare cost-of-living indices, rent indices, and purchasing power across regions (e.g., Western Europe, Asia, Americas) to identify regional patterns and outliers.

required_sections.title: Affordability and Rent Burden Analysis
required_sections.objective: Analyze the rent-to-salary ratio across cities, identify cities where housing costs consume a disproportionate share of income, and examine the relationship between salary levels and rent costs.

required_sections.title: Crisis Tier Profiling
required_sections.objective: Profile each crisis tier and crisis label category, examining the average economic indicators within each group and identifying the characteristics that distinguish high-crisis cities from affluent ones.

required_sections.title: Inflation and Oil Shock Exposure
required_sections.objective: Assess how annual inflation rates and oil shock exposure levels correlate with cost-of-living indices and purchasing power, identifying cities most vulnerable to external economic shocks.

required_sections.title: Key Findings and Policy Implications
required_sections.objective: Synthesize the analysis into actionable findings, highlight the cities and regions requiring urgent attention, and suggest areas for further research or policy focus.

kpis.name: Median Cost of Living Index
kpis.description: The median cost_of_living_index across all 80 cities, providing a central benchmark for global living costs relative to New York.

kpis.name: Average Rent-to-Salary Ratio
kpis.description: The mean rent_to_salary_ratio_pct across all cities, indicating the typical share of income consumed by rent globally.

kpis.name: Purchasing Power Gap
kpis.description: The difference between the highest and lowest local_purchasing_power_index values, measuring the global inequality in purchasing power.

kpis.name: High-Crisis City Count
kpis.description: The number of cities classified in the most severe cost_crisis_tier (highest tier number), indicating the breadth of acute economic stress.

kpis.name: Average Annual Inflation Rate
kpis.description: The mean annual_inflation_rate_2025_pct across all cities, summarizing the global inflationary environment heading into 2026.
